svg.title: What happens after a change that touches the ACL
svg.desc: An edit under sys goes to the registry as a record of the write-ahead log, the ACL is generated from the registry, the router runtime is rebuilt because Zenoh 1.10 has no live ACL reload, and the clients reconnect.
